field_note: BN-01 reproduces an incident observed 2026-07-25 with Hermes wired into the gateway seat: an over-long but entirely legitimate message from the SOVEREIGN was refused by the energy gate, and the connection dropped for ~15s. Field evidence outranks synthetic cases — this one is load-bearing.
